saint-louis-life.author: Nsoderblom
saint-louis-life.description: These fishing boats, pirogues, sit at dock in the inner bay of Saint Louis, at the northern coast of Senegal. Although Senegal has a large fishing industry, almost all the fish are caught on small boats such as these, with the catch being auctioned off to brokers on shore. These fish are sold inland, smoked or dried to preserve them, or frozen for export.
